nameDuplicate: The username “{name}” is already used by another shared user
qrHelp: Scan with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, etc.) or enter the key manually. Takes effect after you save the settings; regenerating invalidates the old key
applyHelp: Click OK to return to Global settings; changes take effect after you save Global settings.
passkeyHelp: Passkeys can only be registered by users on the site; here you can only delete them (for example after losing a device). Deletion takes effect immediately without clicking Save.
passkeyDeleteConfirm: Delete the Passkey "{name}" of user {user}? It can no longer be used to sign in.
